svg.title: Issue 1 — Page 3 — Panel 1: IMPACT — full bridge violently dutch-angled
svg.desc: Wide shot 24mm at 25° dutch angle, violent. THE ATTACK. All 5 squad thrown from positions: Sable thrown sideways catching command console; Wren shields face as engineering display explodes into shards; Jink launched from jump seat; Luma slammed against station, lenses cracking; Thresh through arch braced low. Consoles blowing outward in holographic shrapnel. Hull buckling port side. Red emergency strobing replaces blue-white. Holographic displays fragment into wild geometric shards. SFX: KRAAANG. WREN: CONTACT—!
